assumptions: Door heights 2.1 m and window sill 0.9 m / head 2.4 m assumed; no elevation supplied.
Interior door widths read from swing arcs (~0.88-1.0 m); D4 double door arc span ~1.26 m.
Exterior walls 240 mm thick as annotated; partitions drawn as thin line pairs (centerline used); corridor east wall drawn in two collinear pieces aligned at x=460px centerline.
East door D3 drawn with leaf/arc outside the east face (outward swing) - recorded as observed.
Origin: SW outer corner, x East, y North per north arrow; image y grows south so world y = (878 - pixel_y)/36.3.
declaration.basis:
Outer faces of the annotated 240 external walls: left outer face x=247px and right outer face x=613px carry the 10000 mm top/bottom chains; bottom outer face y=878px and top outer face y=152px carry the 20000 mm side chains (36.3-36.6 px/m).
